glossary.definition: (A) "Carrier or motor carrier" means an individual, partnership, or corporation engaged in the transportation of goods or persons.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4503.60 to 4503.66 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Fleet" means one or more apportionable vehicles.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4503.60 to 4503.66 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Gross vehicle weight" means the unladen weight of a fully equipped vehicle plus the maximum weight of the load to be carried on that vehicle.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4503.60 to 4503.66 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Combined gross vehicle weight" means the total unladen weight of a combination of fully equipped vehicles plus the maximum weight of the load to be carried on that combination of vehicles.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4503.60 to 4503.66 of the Revised Code:
As used in sections 4503.60 to 4503.66 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Jurisdiction" means a state, territory or possession of the United States, the District of Columbia, or a state, province, or territory of another country.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4503.60 to 4503.66 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (G) "Owner-operator" means an equipment lessor who leases his vehicular equipment with a driver to a carrier.
